plan.subject: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its real-world applications.
plan.objective: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its real-world applications.

blocks.title: Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Machine learning relies on mathematical concepts to model and analyze data.
examples: Probability theory, linear algebra, and calculus are fundamental to understanding ML algorithms.

blocks.title: What is Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the core definition of machine learning is essential for grasping its scope and purpose.
examples: Machine learning is a field of study that gives computers the ability to learn without being explicitly programmed.

blocks.title: Real-World Applications of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Seeing how ML is applied in real life helps students appreciate its relevance and impact.
examples: Smart assistants, advertising, and electrical load prediction are practical examples of ML in action.

blocks.title: Why Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the motivations behind ML helps students grasp its importance in modern technology.
examples: ML is used to solve complex problems that are difficult to address with traditional programming methods.

blocks.title: Big Picture of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: A big-picture understanding of ML helps students see how different techniques fit into a larger framework.
examples: The big picture of ML includes supervised and unsupervised learning, as well as reinforcement learning.

blocks.title: Examples of Machine Learning Tasks
blocks.teachingObjective: Concrete examples help students understand how ML is applied in different domains.
examples: Regression, classification, clustering, and reinforcement learning are core ML tasks.
